Experience Center Agents Job at GIG Logistics




        
    

        
        GIG Logistics is a member of The GIG Group and prides itself as Nigeria’s leading logistics company. Incorporated in 2012 and headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria, GIG Logistics leverages on technology to gain competitive advantage.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Experience Center Agents

Job Location: Addo Badore, Lagos

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Provide guidance to walk-in customers on product and service offerings.
	Educate customers and potential customers with information on SLA and delivery timelines.
	Ensure strict adherence to GIGL’s Standard Operating Procedure in the sending, safekeeping, receiving, and releasing of parcels.
	Ensure visibility of shipments as they move through the network through the application of appropriate scans.
	Drive client satisfaction by ensuring that services are delivered according to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA).
	Serve guests by providing product/ service information related to delivery life cycle, rates, and payment.
	Resolve product or service problems by clarifying customers' complaints; determining the cause of the problem; selecting and explaining the best solution to solve the problem; expediting correction or adjustment and following up to ensure resolution.
	Eliminate the possibility of shipping contraband and prohibited goods by ensuring 100% inspection of all parcels brought for shipping.
	Promote and cross-sell company products.


Minimum Requirements


	Computer Literate.
	Graduate
	Done with NYSC.

Administrative Assistant Job at Denver Castle Global Services




        
    

        
        Denver Castle Global Services is a Nigerian company with a global approach to business management solutions. Since 2014, the company has been at the forefront of several ERP-led business transformational programs across several sectors of Nigeria and Sub Saharan Africa. Whether it be Oil and Gas, Manufacturing, Financial Services, FCMG, Aviation, Agro Allied, Telecommunication & Network and in the Public Sector. The company’s service delivery has equally been felt in Distribution, Shipping, Retail, Utilities, Food and Beverages and in the automobile space.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Administrative Assistant

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
     

            
    



Job Description


	The administrative assistant will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation of the administrative functions, including document management, clerical support, and overall office coordination.


Responsibilities 


	Provide administrative support to ensure efficient office operations.
	Manage calendars, distribute memos, schedule meetings, and provide reminders for management.
	Manage schedules, appointments and meetings for staff.
	Manage and maintain accurate records and files.
	Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence (email, phone, mail).
	Maintain office supplies and inventory.
	Collaborate with internal teams to achieve organizational goals.
	Confidentially handle sensitive information.
	Perform other administrative tasks as needed.


Requirements


	Minimum of OND/HND/BSC in a relevant discipline.
	Candidates must have good organizational and administrative skills.
	Good record keeping and document filing skills.
	Must have good oral and written communication skills.
	Excellent analytical skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
	Excellent clerical acumen is highly required.
	Must be ready and be able to work well within a team while maintaining outstanding relationship with all team members.


Salary
N120,000 - N170,000 Monthly.

Method of Application:
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of email.

  "description": "Intelligence Properties is a leading multidisciplinary property service company, privately held and incorporated in Nigeria, providing bespoke solutions across a range of real estate services to owners, occupiers and investors. Over the years we have expanded our services with a foundation based on core strengths, unrivaled local expertise, extensive network and knowledge combined with strategic partnerships.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Architect

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Job type: Full-time (On-site)

  "description": "Excel and Grace Consulting - Our client in the Oil &amp; Gas industry, is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development &amp; Tendering Executive

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Oil &amp; Gas

Job Summary


	The Business Development &amp; Tendering Executive will drive new business opportunities across the oil &amp; gas, construction, marine/dredging, and equipment leasing sectors, focusing on client acquisition, tender opportunities, strategic relationships, contract development, and revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and pursue new contracts, tenders, and business opportunities.
	Manage the business development pipeline from prospecting to contract award.
	Build relationships with IOCs, EPC contractors, government agencies, construction firms, and maritime operators.
	Prepare and submit tenders, proposals, prequalification documents, RFQs/RFPs, and commercial documents.
	Conduct market research and identify upcoming projects, trends, and opportunities.
	Develop and maintain client relationships to drive new and repeat business.
	Collaborate with technical and Operations teams on commercially viable proposals.
	Support negotiations and contract discussions with Management.
	Support market expansion initiatives, including Lagos market entry.
	Maintain accurate pipeline, tender, client, and contract records.
	Prepare business development reports, forecasts, and market intelligence.
	Represent the Group at industry events, client meetings, and networking platforms.
	Perform other duties assigned by Management.


Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree / HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Economics, Management, or related fields
	3&ndash;5 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Sales, Commercial Management, or Tendering.
	Proven experience in oil &amp; gas, construction, marine/dredging, engineering, equipment leasing, or related industries.
	Experience in tendering, prequalification, proposal development, and contract acquisition.
	Strong industry network and client relationships will be an advantage.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, networking, and relationship-management skills.
	Strong commercial awareness and ability to work independently and meet targets.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM/business development tools.
	Must be resident in or willing to work in Port Harcourt.


Salary
N700,000 Monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;

Business Development & Tendering Executive Job at Excel and Grace Consulting




        
    

        
        Excel and Grace Consulting - Our client in the Oil & Gas industry, is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development & Tendering Executive

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Oil & Gas

Job Summary


	The Business Development & Tendering Executive will drive new business opportunities across the oil & gas, construction, marine/dredging, and equipment leasing sectors, focusing on client acquisition, tender opportunities, strategic relationships, contract development, and revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Identify and pursue new contracts, tenders, and business opportunities.
	Manage the business development pipeline from prospecting to contract award.
	Build relationships with IOCs, EPC contractors, government agencies, construction firms, and maritime operators.
	Prepare and submit tenders, proposals, prequalification documents, RFQs/RFPs, and commercial documents.
	Conduct market research and identify upcoming projects, trends, and opportunities.
	Develop and maintain client relationships to drive new and repeat business.
	Collaborate with technical and Operations teams on commercially viable proposals.
	Support negotiations and contract discussions with Management.
	Support market expansion initiatives, including Lagos market entry.
	Maintain accurate pipeline, tender, client, and contract records.
	Prepare business development reports, forecasts, and market intelligence.
	Represent the Group at industry events, client meetings, and networking platforms.
	Perform other duties assigned by Management.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree / HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Economics, Management, or related fields
	3–5 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Sales, Commercial Management, or Tendering.
	Proven experience in oil & gas, construction, marine/dredging, engineering, equipment leasing, or related industries.
	Experience in tendering, prequalification, proposal development, and contract acquisition.
	Strong industry network and client relationships will be an advantage.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, networking, and relationship-management skills.
	Strong commercial awareness and ability to work independently and meet targets.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM/business development tools.
	Must be resident in or willing to work in Port Harcourt.


Salary
N700,000 Monthly.
